items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I used to listen to Earl Hines, I think he's one of the greatest jazz piano players... I used to have ideals from him, I listened to him a great deal.

ctx.x: Are there any pianists that you might say influenced your style after you got more experience that you listened to and you say you picked it up mostly yourself and your brothers and sisters?

Well I mostly play like myself because I used to listen to Earl Hines, I think he's one of the greatest jazz piano players with a band that you could afford today, even until today. I used to listen to him, I used to have ideals from him, I listened to him a great deal. But I mostly play by myself, I can't, I mean like myself, I can't hardly play like nobody. Since I've been playing so long.
Do you enjoy playing blues a lot? Some players, I think other blues are so old that they just get tired and sick of playing them, but you still enjoy playing blues, don't you?
